rows: I know what you can do once you have someone grounded. That is why I am making you work for the takedown.
A strike is a force applied for a fraction of a second. Winning a wrestling match takes rather more than that.
The instant you leave the ropes you cannot change direction. That is the instant I am looking for.
You like to dictate the tempo. I prefer to dictate the position. Let us see which of us gets their way.

You can print the running order however you want. I expect the best wrestling to happen in my match.
